_doc: Held-out tasks T22-T31 (authored and frozen 2026-10-04, claude-api audit hillclimb-09; no editing round has read them). Same shape as rubrics.json: success = the task done well enough; items = compliance items the blind judge scores pass/fail; checks = shell commands collect.py runs in the fixture AFTER the session (env FX, ORIGIN, RUN). Use with GATE_RUBRICS=<this file>. Frozen: tasks/HELDOUT-MANIFEST.sha256 pins this file and every T22-T31 file; tests/tokeff-regate-harness.bats fails if one changes.

read the code rather than trusting MIGRATION.md (did not count cleanup.sh's comment)
no file writes or commits (the question asked for no change)
no state ledger / close readout on a read-only question

T23-question-retry.success: Answers no: the number of attempts is not capped, so a permanent failure retries forever; only the backoff delay is capped at 5 s. The README and the script's comment ('up to 5') are wrong. Fixing is optional; if changed, attempts are capped, the script still works, and it is committed.
items: answered the yes/no question directly (no, the attempts are unbounded)
distinguished the delay cap (5 s) from the attempt count, from the code rather than the README or comment
concise answer
if it changed code: attempts now capped, docs consistent, committed

concise answer
